description: Nocny Lowczy, the legendary Night Huntsman, a towering majestic hunter made of living shadow, a long tattered black cloak billowing around him, a pale stag skull with huge branching antlers instead of a face, cold glowing eyes in the sockets, drawing a great black bow with a dark arrow, a silver-bound black hunting horn at his belt, regal and terrifying, the whole figure inside the picture, full body, three-quarter view
